name: Julius Caesar
title: Dictator of Rome

ability.name: Crossing the Rubicon
ability.description: Declaring war gives your units +5 strength for 10 turns. Each settlement you capture gives 50 gold per citizen.

agenda.name: Imperator
agenda.description: Respects big armies. Dislikes smaller empires that turn down his deals.

quotes.greeting: You stand before Rome. Speak plainly, and Rome will listen.
quotes.war: The die is cast. My legions march on you.
quotes.peace: Let the gates of war close. Rome is generous to those who yield.
quotes.defeat: Even Rome falls. Remember that it stood.

intro: Gaius Julius Caesar: general, consul and master of Rome. Your legions built roads to every corner of the known world, and every road led home. Raise a city of marble, and make the empire eternal.

name: Cleopatra
title: Pharaoh of the Two Lands

ability.name: Serpent of the Nile
ability.description: Each deal you sign gives +1 influence a turn while it lasts. Trade routes to other players give +2 gold to both sides.

agenda.name: Allure
agenda.description: Likes strong militaries. Dislikes weak ones.

quotes.greeting: The Nile has carried your name to my court. Let us see if it was worth carrying.
quotes.war: You mistook my patience for weakness. Egypt will correct you.
quotes.peace: A wise ruler knows when a friend is worth more than a war.
quotes.defeat: The river will remember me, even if you do not.

intro: Cleopatra, last pharaoh of the Two Lands, whose wit outmatched the empires that circled her. The Nile floods, and Egypt grows rich. Build wonders on its banks that will outlast the stars.

name: Alexander the Great
title: King of Macedon

ability.name: Never Defeated
ability.description: Your war support never fades. Capturing a settlement fully heals all your units.

agenda.name: Conqueror
agenda.description: Dislikes players who are at peace with everyone.

quotes.greeting: I have marched farther than any man alive. Your lands are only the next horizon.
quotes.war: Why wait for the world to come to me? I will take yours.
quotes.peace: Very well. My army needs rest, and you have earned a little.
quotes.defeat: I conquered the world once. Someone had to end the march.

intro: Alexander of Macedon, who never lost a battle and never stopped marching. Your companions ride at your side and your phalanx holds the line. Carry your banner to the ends of the earth.

name: Genghis Khan
title: Great Khan of the Mongols

ability.name: Khan of the Steppe
ability.description: Cavalry +3 strength. Defeating an enemy cavalry unit can capture it.

agenda.name: Horde
agenda.description: Respects mounted armies. Dislikes players with few cavalry.

quotes.greeting: The steppe is wide, and my riders have seen its every edge. Who are you?
quotes.war: Your walls will not save you. Nothing has.
quotes.peace: Pay what you owe and live. The khan is satisfied.
quotes.defeat: The wind still blows across the steppe. It will carry my riders again.

intro: Temüjin, who united the clans of the steppe and became the Great Khan. Your riders move faster than any messenger and strike harder than any army. Ride, and let the world learn your name.

name: Elizabeth I
title: Queen of England

ability.name: Gloriana
ability.description: +100% great admiral points. Naval units +1 movement. +1 trade route in each era after the Medieval.

agenda.name: Queen of the Seas
agenda.description: Likes players with big navies who stay off her continent.

quotes.greeting: England greets you. I trust you have come with something worth my time.
quotes.war: I have the heart of a ruler and a fleet to match. You will meet both.
quotes.peace: England has no quarrel with those who keep their word.
quotes.defeat: Let it be written that the queen did not bow.

intro: Elizabeth, the queen who would not marry and would not yield. Your sea dogs rule the waves and your playwrights fill the theaters. Make this island the center of the world.

name: Napoleon Bonaparte
title: Emperor of the French

ability.name: Emperor of the French
ability.description: Commanders gain XP 50% faster. Units within a commander's radius get +2 strength.

agenda.name: Grand Strategist
agenda.description: Respects players with commanders and big armies. Dislikes players who beat him in war.

quotes.greeting: France salutes you. Let us see whether you are a friend, or merely an obstacle.
quotes.war: My marshals are bored. You will give them something to do.
quotes.peace: Glory can wait. France will take its gains in peace.
quotes.defeat: History will judge me kindly. I intend to write it.

intro: Napoleon Bonaparte, the artillery officer who crowned himself emperor. Your grand army marches on new roads under new laws. Remake the world in the image of France.

name: Abraham Lincoln
title: President of the United States

ability.name: A House United
ability.description: Settlements on your home continent +2 happiness. Each Industrial Zone grants a free melee unit.

agenda.name: Union
agenda.description: Dislikes players who start surprise wars. Likes players who keep their promises.

quotes.greeting: Welcome, friend. The American people hope we can do business as neighbors.
quotes.war: We did not seek this fight. But we will finish it.
quotes.peace: Let us bind up these wounds and build something better together.
quotes.defeat: A government of the people does not die with one city.

intro: Abraham Lincoln, the rail-splitter who held a divided nation together. Your people build, settle and invent on a continent of endless promise. Lead them toward a more perfect union.

name: Qin Shi Huang
title: First Emperor of China

ability.name: The First Emperor
ability.description: The first military unit each city trains is free. +15% production toward Ancient and Classical wonders.

agenda.name: Wonder of the World
agenda.description: Likes players who build wonders. Envies anyone who beats him to one.

quotes.greeting: You stand in the presence of the First Emperor. Kneel, or explain why you do not.
quotes.war: All under heaven will be one. Your lands are no exception.
quotes.peace: Order is restored. You may keep your borders, for now.
quotes.defeat: My wall stands. My tomb waits. My name endures.

intro: Qin Shi Huang, who unified the warring states and named himself the First Emperor. Your workers raise walls across mountains and roads that bind the provinces. Build an empire for ten thousand generations.

name: Mansa Musa
title: Mansa of Mali

ability.name: Pilgrimage of Gold
ability.description: International trade routes give +1 gold for each desert tile the origin settlement owns. (Golden ages arrive later.)

agenda.name: Richest Man in History
agenda.description: Likes players with large trade networks. Dislikes poor ones.

quotes.greeting: Peace be with you. Mali has gold enough to share, and patience enough to listen.
quotes.war: Gold buys many things. Today it buys an army.
quotes.peace: Trade is better than war. Let the caravans move again.
quotes.defeat: The salt roads will remember who walked them first.

intro: Mansa Musa, whose pilgrimage scattered so much gold that prices fell in every city he passed. Your caravans cross the desert and your scholars fill Timbuktu. Make Mali the richest empire the world has seen.

name: Oda Nobunaga
title: Lord of Owari

ability.name: The Demon King
ability.description: Melee units +5 strength when attacking a damaged unit. Gunpowder units cost 25% less and get +3 strength.

agenda.name: Unifier
agenda.description: Respects players who take settlements. Dislikes players with weak armies.

quotes.greeting: I have no time for ceremony. State your business.
quotes.war: Life is short. I will not spend mine waiting for you to strike first.
quotes.peace: Very well. The sword returns to its sheath, for now.
quotes.defeat: Fifty years under heaven pass like a dream. So be it.

intro: Oda Nobunaga, the warlord who set out to unify a land at war with itself. Your samurai are disciplined and your guns are many. Bring all of Japan under one rule.

name: Harald Hardrada
title: King of Norway

ability.name: The Hard Ruler
ability.description: Naval melee units +5 strength. Every pillage or plunder also gives 15 culture and 15 faith.

agenda.name: Saga of the Sea
agenda.description: Respects a strong fleet. Scorns the weak at sea.

rules.label: Your fleet is a joke to him

quotes.greeting: I have sailed from Miklagard to the edge of the world. Your shores are only the next.
quotes.war: The longships are already on the water. Ready your walls.
quotes.peace: Even the hardest ruler knows when the plunder is not worth the oars.
quotes.defeat: A good saga ends in a good death. Sing mine well.

intro: Harald Sigurdsson, called Hardrada: exile, mercenary captain of the Varangian Guard, and king of Norway. Your ships go where others fear the swell, and every coast is a door. Take the sea, and the land will follow.

name: Shaka
title: King of the Zulu

ability.name: Horns of the Buffalo
ability.description: Commanders give +3 strength to units in their radius and gain XP 50% faster. Melee and anti-cavalry units +3 strength when attacking.

agenda.name: Iron Discipline
agenda.description: Respects strong armies. Despises the weak.

quotes.greeting: You stand before the king of the Zulu. Stand straight, then.
quotes.war: The horns close around you. There is no way out but through my warriors.
quotes.peace: Peace, for now. My regiments will drill while we talk.
quotes.defeat: Even the buffalo falls at last. But not before it tramples many.

intro: Shaka kaSenzangakhona, king of the Zulu: a soldier who remade an army and an army that remade a nation. Drill your regiments, close the horns around your enemies, and let no one forget your name.

name: Montezuma
title: Huey Tlatoani of the Mexica

ability.name: Flower Wars
ability.description: Your soldiers have a 25% chance to capture the melee, anti-cavalry and ranged units they defeat. Capturing a settlement heals every unit you have.

agenda.name: Tribute of Jade
agenda.description: Covets the wonders of others. Respects warriors.

quotes.greeting: The Fifth Sun shines on Tenochtitlan. You may approach the speaker.
quotes.war: The flowers of war are blooming. You will make a fine offering.
quotes.peace: The gods are fed for now. We may trade.
quotes.defeat: The sun sets on the Mexica. It will rise again.

intro: Moctezuma Ilhuicamina, Huey Tlatoani of the Mexica: the speaker who built an empire of tribute on a lake. Your warriors take captives, not lives, and your city floats on gardens. Feed the sun, and the world will pay you tribute.

name: Hannibal Barca
title: General of Carthage

ability.name: Over the Mountains
ability.description: Units +5 strength fighting on hills. Cavalry +3 strength.

agenda.name: Barcid Oath
agenda.description: Hates those who break the peace without warning. Respects a worthy foe.

quotes.greeting: I have crossed rivers, sea and mountains to stand where no one thought I could. Speak.
quotes.war: I swore an oath as a boy. You have just become part of it.
quotes.peace: A truce. Carthage trades with everyone who keeps their word.
quotes.defeat: I never lost my nerve. Only my allies.

intro: Hannibal Barca, general of Carthage: the man who brought elephants over the Alps. Your merchants sail every sea and your armies go where maps say they cannot. Make the mountains your road.

name: Saladin
title: Sultan of Egypt and Syria

ability.name: Chivalry of the Sultan
ability.description: Cavalry +4 strength when defending. Every city +2 faith.

agenda.name: Defender of the Faithful
agenda.description: Honors those who keep the peace. Detests those who break it without cause.

quotes.greeting: Peace be upon you. My tent is open to honest guests.
quotes.war: I take no joy in this. But I have never lost a war I was given no choice in.
quotes.peace: Mercy is the better part of strength. Let us end this.
quotes.defeat: I leave nothing behind but my name. Let it be a good one.

intro: Salah ad-Din Yusuf ibn Ayyub, sultan of Egypt and Syria: a ruler famous even among his enemies for his justice. Your scholars teach in the shadow of your mosques, and your horsemen hold the line. Rule with mercy, and fight with honor.

name: Catherine the Great
title: Empress of All the Russias

ability.name: Patron of the Hermitage
ability.description: +50% great writer, artist and musician points. +1 wildcard policy slot.

agenda.name: Enlightened Empress
agenda.description: Admires civs with great wonders. Thinks those with none uncultured.

quotes.greeting: Welcome to the Russian court. Do sit; we have much to discuss, and all of it in French.
quotes.war: I would rather have written you a letter. You have left me only the army.
quotes.peace: Splendid. An empress collects friends as she collects paintings.
quotes.defeat: History will be kinder to me than you have been.

intro: Catherine II, called the Great: empress of a frontier that never seems to end. You fill your palaces with art and your borders with new land. Be enlightened, be ambitious, and let the world come to admire Russia.

name: Ashoka
title: Emperor of the Maurya

ability.name: Edicts of the Law
ability.description: While celebrating, settlements +3 faith and +2 culture.

agenda.name: Wheel of the Law
agenda.description: Loves those who keep the peace. Hates warmongers.

quotes.greeting: All people are my children. You are welcome here, child.
quotes.war: I have seen what war does at Kalinga. You leave me no other road, and I grieve it.
quotes.peace: Good. The law of righteousness is the only true conquest.
quotes.defeat: I conquered once and repented. Perhaps you will too.

intro: Ashoka Maurya, emperor of almost all of India: the conqueror who turned his back on conquest. Your edicts are carved in stone across the land, and your people celebrate in peace. Rule by the law, and the world will follow it.

name: Suleiman the Magnificent
title: Sultan of the Ottomans

ability.name: The Lawgiver
ability.description: +1 happiness and +2 loyalty in every settlement.

agenda.name: Magnificence
agenda.description: Admires grand wonders. Dislikes those who start wars without warning.

quotes.greeting: You have come to the Sublime Porte. Few arrive with nothing to ask.
quotes.war: The bombards have not been cast for ornament.
quotes.peace: Let it be written down and sealed. The law binds us both.
quotes.defeat: Even the magnificent are only men.

intro: Suleiman I, the Magnificent to his rivals and the Lawgiver to his people: sultan of an empire on three continents. Your guns break any wall and your law holds every city you take. Be just, be magnificent, and be feared.

name: Pachacuti
title: Sapa Inca

ability.name: Earth-Shaker
ability.description: Campuses +1 science for each neighboring mountain. Settlements grow 10% faster.

agenda.name: Children of the Sun
agenda.description: Likes peaceful neighbors. Wary of big armies.

rules.label: Your army is too close for comfort

quotes.greeting: From Qusqu the four quarters of the world are ruled. You stand in one of them.
quotes.war: The mountains will not hide you, and my roads reach everywhere.
quotes.peace: Good. There is enough work in the terraces for all of us.
quotes.defeat: The world turns over. Pachacuti knows; it was my name.

intro: Pachacuti Inca Yupanqui, the Sapa Inca: the "earth-shaker" who turned a mountain kingdom into an empire of roads. Your terraces climb the hills and your runners cross the peaks. Shake the earth, and build on what falls.

name: Boudica
title: Queen of the Iceni

ability.name: Fury of the Iceni
ability.description: Units +4 strength fighting in woods or rainforest, and +3 strength attacking settlements.

agenda.name: Never Conquered
agenda.description: Distrusts big armies and conquerors.

quotes.greeting: I am Boudica of the Iceni. I bow to no one, and I do not expect you to bow to me.
quotes.war: Every wrong is remembered in the woods. Today they are answered.
quotes.peace: Peace, then, while you keep your word. The tribes will know if you do not.
quotes.defeat: They took my land, but they never took me.

intro: Boudica, queen of the Iceni: the widow who led the tribes against an empire and burned its cities. Your warriors know every grove and your druids keep the old ways. Rally the tribes, and let no one rule you.

name: Charlemagne
title: Emperor of the West

ability.name: Peers of the Realm
ability.description: +1 military policy slot. Heavy cavalry +4 strength.

agenda.name: Father of Europe
agenda.description: Admires mounted knights. Dislikes those who start wars without warning.

quotes.greeting: You come before the emperor of the Franks. Kneel or stand, but be quick.
quotes.war: My paladins are saddled. You should have chosen your words better.
quotes.peace: Good. There are schools to build and books to copy.
quotes.defeat: An empire is a book. Someone else will write the next chapter.

intro: Charles the Great, king of the Franks and emperor of the West: the warrior who could barely write and filled his court with scholars. Your knights ride in front and your scribes follow behind. Unite the lands, and light the lamps of learning.

name: Cyrus the Great
title: King of Kings

ability.name: King of the Four Corners
ability.description: Units +2 strength for 10 turns after declaring war. Capturing a settlement gives a boost per district in it.

agenda.name: Tolerant Conqueror
agenda.description: Respects fellow conquerors. Scorns the weak.

quotes.greeting: I am Cyrus, king of the world. My gates are open, if you come in friendship.
quotes.war: I have taken cities with an open hand before. Yours I will take with a closed one.
quotes.peace: Let your gods and mine both be honored. Peace.
quotes.defeat: Do not begrudge me this little earth that covers my body.

intro: Cyrus II of Persia, king of kings: the conqueror who let the peoples he conquered keep their gods and go home. Your roads bind an empire of many nations. Conquer, and let the conquered thank you for it.

name: Sejong the Great
title: King of Joseon

ability.name: Letters for the People
ability.description: Settlements with a Library +1 science. +50% great scientist points.

agenda.name: Scholar King
agenda.description: Likes peaceful neighbors. Distrusts big armies.

quotes.greeting: Welcome. Tell me what your scholars are working on; I am always curious.
quotes.war: I would rather invent than destroy. You have given me something new to invent.
quotes.peace: Wise. Let us both go back to our books.
quotes.defeat: The letters I made will outlive us both.

intro: Sejong of Joseon, called the Great: the king who gave his people an alphabet so that anyone could learn to read. Your scholars measure the rain and the stars. Learn everything, and teach everyone.

name: Theodora
title: Empress of the Romans

ability.name: From the Hippodrome
ability.description: Settlements with an Arena +2 happiness. Settlements with a Holy Site +2 faith.

agenda.name: Purple-Born Politics
agenda.description: Admires a full treasury. Distrusts surprise wars.

quotes.greeting: The empress receives you. Mind the purple; it is not for everyone.
quotes.war: Royalty is a good burial shroud. I will not run from you.
quotes.peace: A sensible choice. The city has seen enough riots.
quotes.defeat: I stayed when others fled. That is all anyone can ask.

intro: Theodora, empress of the Romans in Constantinople: an actress from the Hippodrome who rose to rule beside Justinian. Your fleets burn with fire no one can put out, and your faith fills the domes. Keep your nerve, and keep the city.

name: Isabella
title: Queen of Castile

ability.name: Patron of Explorers
ability.description: Naval melee units start with Helmsman (+1 movement). International trade routes +3 gold.

agenda.name: Crown of Castile
agenda.description: Sees rivals at sea. Respects a full treasury.

quotes.greeting: You are received by the queen of Castile. Spain listens; it does not wait.
quotes.war: I have pawned my jewels for a war before. Do not think I will not again.
quotes.peace: Agreed. Our ships have better places to sail.
quotes.defeat: I gave the world a new world. Remember that.

intro: Isabella I, queen of Castile: the monarch who united a kingdom and sent ships across an ocean no one had crossed. Your missions reach the frontier and your fleets reach everywhere else. Look past the horizon, and claim what lies beyond.

name: Pericles
title: First Citizen of Athens

ability.name: School of Hellas
ability.description: Settlements with a Theater Square +2 culture. +1 wildcard policy slot.

agenda.name: Delian League
agenda.description: Likes peaceful neighbors and admires great wonders.

quotes.greeting: Welcome to Athens. Here we argue, vote and build. Which have you come for?
quotes.war: We do not seek war, but we do not fear it. The assembly has voted.
quotes.peace: Good. Our time is better spent on the Acropolis.
quotes.defeat: What we leave behind is not carved in stone, but woven into the lives of others.

intro: Pericles, first citizen of Athens: the general and orator who built the Parthenon and made his city the school of Greece. Your theaters fill and your temples rise on every hill. Build beautifully, and argue well.

name: Lady Six Sky
title: Queen of Sa'aal

ability.name: Warrior Queen of Sa'aal
ability.description: Farms +0.5 science. Units +3 strength fighting in rainforest or woods.

agenda.name: Watcher of the Sky
agenda.description: Covets great wonders. Likes peaceful neighbors.

quotes.greeting: The sky has turned and brought you here. I am Lady Six Sky of Sa'aal.
quotes.war: The stars have shown me the day. It is today.
quotes.peace: Peace, then, until the calendar says otherwise.
quotes.defeat: The count goes on without me. It always does.

intro: Lady Six Sky, queen of Sa'aal: the warrior queen who refounded a fallen city and won its wars for decades. Your farmers feed your astronomers, and your cities stay close to the throne. Read the sky, and act before others can.

name: Hammurabi
title: King of Babylon

ability.name: Law of the Land
ability.description: Boosts give 40% more of a tech or civic. All science 15% lower.

agenda.name: Code of Laws
agenda.description: Hates surprise wars. Likes those who keep the peace.

quotes.greeting: I am Hammurabi, who set the law in stone so the strong would not oppress the weak.
quotes.war: An eye for an eye. You struck first.
quotes.peace: Let it be written and witnessed. The law binds us.
quotes.defeat: The law will outlast the king.

intro: Hammurabi, king of Babylon: the ruler who carved his laws on a pillar for all to see. Your scribes keep the records and your scholars read the stars. Write it down, and the world will run by your rules.

name: Pedro II
title: Emperor of Brazil

ability.name: The Magnanimous
ability.description: +20% great scientist, engineer, merchant, writer, artist and musician points.

agenda.name: Patron of the Arts and Sciences
agenda.description: Admires great wonders. Dislikes big armies.

rules.label: Too many soldiers for his taste

quotes.greeting: Welcome! Have you brought any books? Or a telephone? I collect both.
quotes.war: I am a patient man. You have found the end of my patience.
quotes.peace: Splendid. Let us sponsor something together instead.
quotes.defeat: I would rather have been a schoolteacher anyway.

intro: Pedro II, emperor of Brazil: the scholar-king who reigned for half a century and spent it on schools, science and the arts. Your forests are rich and your great people many. Be generous, and be remembered.

name: Menelik II
title: Emperor of Ethiopia

ability.name: Victor of Adwa
ability.description: Units +4 strength fighting on hills. Hills tiles +1 faith.

agenda.name: Never Colonized
agenda.description: Hates conquerors. Likes peaceful neighbors.

quotes.greeting: You are welcome in the highlands. Keep to the roads; the mountains are ours.
quotes.war: Others came with rifles and promises. They went home with neither.
quotes.peace: Peace. Ethiopia has outlasted every empire that came for it.
quotes.defeat: You have won a battle, not the highlands.

intro: Menelik II, emperor of Ethiopia: the king who modernized an ancient realm and defeated an invading army at Adwa. Your highlands are your fortress and your faith is older than most kingdoms. Hold the heights, and let no one take them.
